subject: Deku Scrub
text: A Deku Scrub inside Dodongo's Cavern sells Deku Sticks for 15 Rupees apiece.

evidence.quote:
This scrub will sell you Deku Sticks at 15 
Rupees apiece, you'll need a few but I'm sure you likely already have some.

subject: Torch puzzle
text: Lighting all three unlit torches with a lit Deku Stick opens the door at the end of the hall.

evidence.quote:
Whip out a Deku Stick and then light it on fire 
using the torch in this room, use that Deku Stick to light all of the other 
three torches and that will open the door at the end of the hall.

subject: Cracked wall
text: Blasting open the cracked wall beside the platform reveals a large treasure chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Grab 
a bomb from out of the Bomb Flower and use it on the cracked wall beside you, 
this wall will crumble and reveal a large treasure chest inside.  Open the 
chest to acquire the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Enormous chest
text: Defeating the living statue enemy with a bomb and sword slash allows Link to open an enormous chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
You can only kill it with a bomb and it 
only comes alive once you touch it, so the solution is to throw a bomb at it, 
then when the bomb glows red, slash the enemy with your sword and run like 
hell.  That should take care of him no problem.  Open the enormous chest and 
you will receive the COMPASS for this dungeon, that will come in handy, now we 
can start using more accurate directions, keep an eye on your minimap.

subject: Bomb Flower chain
text: Placing a bomb in the empty middle space between the Bomb Flowers sets off a chain reaction that lowers the central structure into stairs.

evidence.quote:
there is a single Bomb 
Flower growing near the door you just came through, and there is no 
Bomb Flower growing in the exact middle of all the other ones.  The solution 
of course is to take the bomb from out of the flower beside the door and set 
it down in that empty space.  When the bomb explodes it will also ignite the 
two bombs on its left and right, and then they will ignite the next two etc.  
Eventually when all is said, done, and blown up, those explosions weakened the 
concrete structure in the middle and now you can climb up the stairs.

subject: Climbable wall
text: Above the stairs, a Gold Skulltula crawls on the wall above a normal Skulltula and can be defeated using the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote:
When you arrive you'll notice that there is a Skulltula crawling around on the 
wall which you can kill with a Jump Attack, and above it is a Gold Skulltula 
which you can kill using your Fairy Slingshot.  This wall is climb-able, so 
climb up and grab your GOLD SKULLTULA [013] then head through the door.

subject: Pillar chest
text: A small chest located on a pillar with a Bomb Flower contains a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote:
drop down onto the pillar with the Bomb Flower and the small chest 
containing a RED RUPEE.

subject: Bomb wall
text: To blast down the wall at the top of the ladder, Link must hold a bomb until it flashes rapidly and wait approximately one second before throwing it.

evidence.quote:
Your timing for this next thing has to be perfect, 
lift a bomb above your head and wait.  Let it start flashing red and keep 
holding it.  When it starts flashing extremely fast, wait approximately one 
second or so and then throw the bomb at the wall at the top of the ladder.  It 
should blast it down.

subject: Eyeball switches
text: Shooting the eyeball switches above the doors with the Fairy Slingshot extinguishes the blocking flames.

evidence.quote:
Equip your Fairy Slingshot and aim it up at the eyeball above the door at the 
end here.  Now that the flames have been extinguished, jump across to the door 
on the other side and proceed through the hall....Extinguish the flame by using your Fairy Slingshot to fire up at the eyeball 
above the door.  After the flame has been extinguished, jump to the platform 
and aim left.  There is another eyeball in here which will extinguish the 
second flame.

subject: Large treasure chest
text: A large treasure chest contains the Bomb Bag, which comes equipped with a maximum carrying capacity of 20 bombs.

evidence.quote:
here inside the 
large treasure chest you will find the BOMB BAG.  The Bomb Bag allows you to 
place bombs yourself rather than relying on Bomb Flowers, this particular bag 
comes equipped with a maximum carrying capacity of 20 bombs.

subject: Bridge wall chest
text: Blasting open the wall past the large bridge reveals a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Use your 
newly acquired Bomb Bag to blast open this wall and reveal a small chest 
containing a BLUE RUPEE.

subject: Giant skull mouth
text: Dropping a bomb into each of the two bridge gaps illuminates both eye cavities and opens the giant skull's mouth.

evidence.quote:
Now on your way back, note that there are two gaps 
in the bridge.  Stand right at the edge of the first gap and use a bomb.  Drop 
it down the gap and wait for it to explode.  It should land in the eye cavity 
and make the little secret noise.  Now do the same thing, drop another bomb 
down the other bridge gap and when both eyes are illuminated, the mouth opens.

subject: Statue
text: Behind a movable statue in the north room of the cavern lies a Gold Skulltula token.

evidence.quote:
Drop a bomb beside the statue in this room, kill it if you wish but all 
that matters is that it gets out of the way because behind it is another GOLD 
SKULLTULA [014].  Grab the token and leave the room.

subject: Small treasure chest
text: Opening the small treasure chest through the west door yields Bombs.

evidence.quote:
When 
you're ready, head through the west door and open the small treasure chest 
here to acquire BOMBS.

subject: King Dodongo
text: Standing on the 45 degree slope between the path and central lava grants immunity to all of King Dodongo's attacks.

evidence.quote:
First of all you should 
acquaint yourself with the little 45 degree slope between the path you are on 
and the lava in the middle, while standing on this slope you are immune to all 
his attacks.

subject: King Dodongo
text: Throwing a bomb into King Dodongo's mouth as he breathes in stuns him for a Jump Attack, taking as few as three Jump Attacks or four normal attacks to defeat him.

evidence.quote:
He stops and begins to suck in air for 
his fire breath attack which launches a blast of fire down the path and around 
the corner.  What you have to do is lift a bomb above your head while the boss 
is breathing in, and then throw it into his mouth.  When the bomb explodes the 
boss drops down and that is your chance to hit him exactly once.  Use the Jump 
Attack when he falls....It should take only four hits to kill the boss with normal 
attacks, and as little as three with the Jump Attack.  He will never be able 
to use his fire breath as long as you always throw a bomb into his mouth.

subject: King Dodongo
text: Defeating King Dodongo leaves behind a Heart Container in the middle of the room.

evidence.quote:
When the boss is defeated he will roll himself into the lava in 
the middle of the map and then just die, solidifying it in the process.  Grab 
the HEART CONTAINER from the middle of the room and take the warp back 
outside.

subject: Spinning urn
text: Throwing bombs into the spinning urn until it lands on the happy face causes a Piece of Heart to pop out.

evidence.quote:
What you have 
to do is stand at the side here and throw bombs from your Bomb Bag into the 
urn.  If you manage to get one in successfully then the urn will spin around 
in circles even faster and more wildly.  Note the three different expressions 
on the side of it, one happy, one neutral and one angry.  Your goal is to spin 
it so it lands on the happy face and when it does, a PIECE OF HEART [007] will 
pop out.

subject: Rolling Goron
text: Stopping the rolling Goron by detonating a bomb under him inside the tunnel rewards Link with the Big Bomb Bag, which carries 30 bombs instead of 20.

evidence.quote:
Notice that on the 
north side there is kind of an underpass, a closed in tunnel that the Goron 
passes through.  Drop a bomb from your Bomb Bag in the middle of this tunnel 
and time it so that the bomb explodes just as the Goron is rolling over top of 
it.  For doing this successfully the Goron rewards you with the BIG BOMB BAG 
which allows you to carry 30 bombs instead of a mere 20.

subject: Rock maze
text: At the end of the rock maze past the three medium rocks are two chests each containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
On the west side of the path there are three medium sized rocks sitting in 
your way.  Take a bomb out of your new, larger Bomb Bag and place it in front 
of these three rocks to blast them out of the way.  This path now leads you 
through a little tunnel.  At the end of this tunnel you will find a kind of 
rock maze....At the end you will find two 
chests containing a PURPLE RUPEE, and another PURPLE RUPEE.

subject: Crate
text: Smashing the crate behind the two chests at the end of the rock maze reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Behind these two 
treasure chests is a crate, smash the crate by rolling into it with the A 
button to reveal a Skulltula.  When you defeat the enemy you can pick up the 
GOLD SKULLTULA [015].
